summary: The fix meets all five acceptance criteria (AC1 both reported false positives allowed; AC2 real force pushes to main/master still blocked in every form tested; AC3 --force-with-lease handled explicitly; AC4 target taken from the push's own arguments; AC5 regression tests include both reported cases plus a block-list and unit tests of the new script). Scope additions judged in scope: a bare force push is judged by the checked-out branch, --all/--mirror count as pushing main, bash -c commands are checked. force_push_guard.py fails open on internal error (design choice for the code-reviewer). Reviewer could not run tests (read-only tools). Stage 2 (code-reviewer) can proceed.
